core_obligations: Variable case (proof line 1275): marked exercise by the author - the base identity when M is the substituted variable itself or unrelated.

Application case (lines 1276-1282): definedness splits into both subterms; membership x in FV(PQ) gives x in FV(P) or x in FV(Q); the concluding set algebra is left as an exercise after the author states both ingredients.

Abstraction case (lines 1283-1298): with M = lambda y.P the chain of five equalities computes FV of the substituted abstraction, applying the induction hypothesis at the body and x not in FV(N) at the fourth step.
proof_roadmap: Induct on the formation of M.
Discharge the variable case as the immediate identity.
For applications combine the two induction hypotheses by the membership split.
For abstractions unfold both FV and substitution clause by clause and apply the hypothesis to the body.
difficulty_reason: The exact free-variable calculus under substitution when the variable actually occurs (statement 1267-1270, proof 1272-1299). The load-bearing abstraction case is a complete five-line computation; the base variable case is trivial and the application case states both of its ingredients before leaving the routine set-union bookkeeping as an exercise. H2: one full induction case plus two elementary ones.
